fact: On 18 October 2026 the Machadka Isgaarsiinta iyo Teknolojiyadda Qaranka (NTTI) launched a programme to build the digital knowledge of government employees, starting with a workshop on data protection.
title: Machadka NTTI oo Daahfuray Barnaamij Lagu Tayeynayo Aqoonta Dijitaalka ah ee Shaqaalaha Dowladda
